title: At phone width the line window shows the same Title and Description words
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin (all permissions) at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919) on the What/Why QA build.
  • Customer {Customer-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-WW-A03 Fleet) has a contact person and an asset, {Asset-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-WW-A03 Truck).
  • Work order {Work-order-1} (for example S2-15440) is open for {Customer-A} and {Asset-A} at {Location-A}, not invoiced.
  • {Work-order-1} has a line {Line-1} with Title (for example Replace tie rod) and Description (for example excessive play).
  • Your browser window can be narrowed to 600 pixels wide or less, or you can open the What/Why QA build on a phone.
custom_steps:
1. Narrow the browser window to 600 pixels wide or less (or open the build on a phone).
  2. Open {Work-order-1} and go to its Lines tab.
  3. Click New Line.
  4. Read the labels and the grey text inside the first two fields.
  5. Close the window without saving.
  6. Click {Line-1}'s title to open Edit Line.
  7. Read the labels and values of the first two fields.
  8. Close the window without saving.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 4: the first field reads "Title" with the prompt "What are you doing?" and the second reads "Description" with the prompt "Why are you doing it?", the same words as at full width.
  • Step 7: the fields read "Title" and "Description" and show {Line-1}'s saved values.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-11257; story SV-10130 (Story 1, The Work Order Line Dialog); PRD "What Are You Doing / Why Are You Doing It (What/Why)", Confluence 845348896, version of 13 Oct 2026, S1-R1, S1-R2, S1-R3, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas board 1.2 (New Line - after) and 1.5 (Edit Line - after), 13 Oct copy; PRD section Form Factor; Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (a What/Why QA build exists; verification by the build verification session).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-R1: “The first field is labeled exactly "Title".”
  • S1-R2: “The second field is labeled exactly "Description".”
  • S1-R3: “The Title box carries the placeholder "What are you doing?" and the Description box carries "Why are you doing it?". Placeholder text shows while the box is empty and disappears as soon as there is a value.”
  • PRD Form Factor: “This spec changes two labels and two placeholders inside it and nothing else: the mobile variant shows the same words, in the same fields, with no separate design work owed.”
